## PCIe Subsystem Clock/Reset Verification Plan

### 1. Clock Sources

Based on §4.4.1 (p.22), the PCIe subsystem has three categories of clock sources:

| # | Clock Source | Supplies | Ref Clk Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **SoC PLL input** | `pcie_cfg_clk` (250MHz) for NoC, system registers | SoC clock tree |
| 2 | **Subsystem local PLL (CRG)** | AMBA-related logic: `axi_clk` (1GHz), `cr_clk` (125MHz), `local_ref_clk` (100MHz) | PHY mplla/mpllb 100MHz or `clk_ref_clk` 20MHz (§1.15, p.9) |
| 3 | **PHY built-in PLL (MPLL)** | PHY, PIPE interface, Controller master clock: `core_clk`, `pclk`, `pipe_rx_clk` | PAD differential clock input (per-PHY: PHY0 can originate, PHY1-3 daisy-chain) |

**PLL reference clock selection** (3 options, §4.4.1 p.22):
- PHY mplla `refa_dig_fr_clk` 100MHz
- PHY mpllb `refb_dig_fr_clk` 100MHz
- Chip reference clock `clk_ref_clk` 20MHz

**PHY reference clock topology** (3 modes, §4.4.1 p.22):
- PHY0 from PAD, PHY1~3 daisy-chain from prior PHY
- PHY0 from local PLL output, PHY1~3 daisy-chain
- All 4 PHYs from own PAD inputs (must be consistent source)

**Test mode outputs** (§1.15, p.10): `clk_test0` 2GHz, `clk_test1` 1GHz, `clk_test2` 125MHz, `clk_test3` 100MHz
